name: build-graph
description: Live Rust architecture graph from build-graph, refreshed on save.

buildGraph.autoStart.description: Start the watcher automatically when a Cargo workspace opens.

buildGraph.command.markdownDescription: Base command. Use `cargo build-graph` (installed) or an absolute path to the binary.

buildGraph.references.markdownDescription: Layer 3 references backend: `driver` (fast, incremental — needs the `rustc-driver` feature build), `rust-analyzer` (`--references`), or `none` (Layers 1–2 only).

buildGraph.extraArgs.description: Extra args appended to every build-graph invocation (e.g. --nightly, --no-derives).

buildGraph.outDir.description: Graph output directory, relative to the workspace root (must match --out).
